rca.principle: Exit 137 is SIGKILL, not necessarily an OOM kill. Count memory pressure only when Kubernetes last_reason is OOMKilled. The rest is PROBE-KILL.

findings.title: OOMKilled then CrashLoopBackOff
findings.evidence: 7 restarts, last exit 137, last_reason=OOMKilled, liveness HTTP 000, memory at the 1536 MiB limit.
findings.likely_cause: MAE consumer applying MetadataAuditEvent traffic while Elasticsearch bulk indexing lagged; heap plus off-heap buffers hit the pod limit.
findings.suggested: Raise the mae-consumer memory limit toward 2Gi, inspect Kafka lag on MetadataAuditEvent_v4, confirm Elasticsearch is accepting bulk index requests.

findings.title: MAE Kafka listener concurrency is 1
findings.evidence: platform.mae_kafka_listener_concurrency=1 with MAE already OOM looping.
findings.likely_cause: Single-threaded apply cannot drain MetadataAuditEvent_v4, so UI search goes stale while GMS counts still look fine.
findings.suggested: Raise MAE listener concurrency with partition count; only after memory headroom exists.

findings.title: Executor memory high between UI ingestions
findings.evidence: 1802 / 2048 MiB in the 5m fixture window; 1 restart on the executor pod.
findings.likely_cause: acryl-datahub-actions runs UI ingestion recipes in-process (the executor action).
findings.suggested: Stagger postgres and oracle recipes; avoid overlapping hourly postgres-analytics with an on-demand run.

findings.title: Prior Error restart, now Running
findings.likely_cause: Transient MCE apply failure (proposal rejected or GMS timeout) that recovered.
findings.suggested: Watch mce-consumer logs on the next ingestion; no config change from this fixture alone.

app_config.note: Synthetic sizing for the fictional DataHub lab tenant. Not a vendor capacity guide. Numbers are derived from the cluster, metrics, ingestion, and RCA fixtures.
blockers: datahub-mae-consumer is OOMKilled at 1536 MiB while serving 140 assets. Do not scale ingestion until this limit is raised.

changes.why: MAE already sits at the pod limit. Search/index apply is the first wall.
GraphQL + ingestProposal + search fan-out at 1M entities.
MCP apply volume follows ingestion, not UI traffic.
Executor already at 88% memory between two small sources.
Dataset + timeseries + search indices dominate storage.
One partition cannot drain 1M-asset audit traffic.
GMS aspect rows and usage stats grow with unique urns.
10× the 1M MAE plan; keep consumer lag near zero or search goes stale.
Search and GraphQL become the hot path; one replica will timeout.
Bulk ingest windows otherwise back up MetadataChangeEvent_v4.

changes.to: dedicated executor pool 4× 8Gi; no overlapping hourly recipes
changes.why: In-process recipes at 10M will OOM the single executor.

changes.to: 5 data nodes heap 31g, disk multi-TB, ILM for timeseries
changes.why: Index size, not GMS heap, is the usual 10M ceiling.

changes.to: MAE 36 / MCE 24, retention sized to peak ingest
changes.why: Need parallel apply plus replay room after MAE incidents.

changes.to: primary 32Gi + read replica for UI browse
changes.why: Entity aspect tables and relationships stop fitting a lab-sized instance.

rca.symptom: Dataset search in the UI returns no rows even though GraphQL assetCounts still reports 115 datasets.
evidence: open incident inc-1001 Search index lag after MAE consumer OOM
rca.cause: MAE consumer cannot apply MetadataAuditEvent_v4, so Elasticsearch search documents are stale. List/count APIs that read GMS still pass; the UI search path does not.
rca.fix: Raise datahub-mae-consumer memory toward 2Gi, confirm Kafka lag on MetadataAuditEvent_v4, then reindex. Do not treat this as a frontend selector bug.

evidence: mce-consumer is Running but has 2 prior Error restarts
rca.cause: upstreamLineage aspects are stored on GMS, but the UI lineage explorer hydrates through the search/graph index that MAE maintains.
rca.fix: Restore mae-consumer, then reload the dataset urn. No recipe change required.

cases.name: MAE consumer memory under 90% of limit

rca.symptom: MAE pod has zero memory headroom.
evidence: metrics fixture cpu 88.1%, memory at limit
rca.cause: 1536 MiB is too small for MAE + Elasticsearch bulk buffers at even 140 assets.
rca.fix: This is the first config change before any 1M / 10M ingest plan.

recipes.postgres:
pipeline_name: postgres-lab-demo
source:
  type: postgres
  config:
    host_port: db.lab.example:5432
    database: analytics
    username: datahub_reader
    password: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    include_tables: true
    include_views: true
    schema_pattern:
      allow:
        - public
        - reporting
    table_pattern:
      allow:
        - public.orders
        - public.customers
        - public.inventory
        - reporting.daily_kpis
sink:
  type: datahub-rest
  config:
    server: http://datahub-gms:8080
recipes.oracle:
pipeline_name: oracle-finance-daily
source:
  type: oracle
  config:
    host_port: oracle.lab.example:1521
    username: datahub_reader
    password: ${ORACLE_PASSWORD}
    service_name: FINLAB
    include_tables: true
    include_views: true
    schema_pattern:
      allow:
        - FINAPP
        - REFDATA
sink:
  type: datahub-rest
  config:
    server: http://datahub-gms:8080

endpoints.title: Frontend / GMS login
endpoints.summary: Create a session. This lab accepts JSON {username, password}. Fictional user emuser / empass. Not a live tenant.

endpoints.title: List incidents (alerts)
endpoints.summary: GraphQL listIncidents. This lab uses DataHub incidents for the word “alerts”. Returns open count and titles from the alerts fixture.

endpoints.title: List ingestion sources
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query listIngestionSources(input: ListIngestionSourcesInput!). Returns urn, name, type, schedule, nested executions.

endpoints.title: Create an ingestion source
endpoints.summary: GraphQL mutation createIngestionSource(input: UpdateIngestionSourceInput!). type must match the recipe (postgres, oracle). config.recipe is a JSON-encoded recipe. config.executorId is the datahub-actions executor.

endpoints.title: Update an ingestion source
endpoints.summary: GraphQL mutation updateIngestionSource(urn, input: UpdateIngestionSourceInput!).

endpoints.title: Create an ingestion execution request
endpoints.summary: GraphQL mutation createIngestionExecutionRequest. Required input: ingestionSourceUrn. Returns the run / execution-request urn. datahub-actions executes it.

endpoints.title: List execution requests
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query listExecutionRequests. Poll result.status PENDING | RUNNING | SUCCESS | FAILURE.

endpoints.title: Get one ingestion source
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query ingestionSource(urn: String!).

endpoints.title: Search across entities
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query searchAcrossEntities. Use types DATASET, CONTAINER, DATA_JOB for asset counts in this lab. Not used for INGESTION_SOURCE run history.

endpoints.title: Get a dataset by urn
endpoints.summary: GraphQL query dataset(urn). Aspects such as schemaMetadata, upstreamLineage, datasetProperties.

endpoints.title: GMS health
endpoints.summary: datahub-gms process health. Mock returns ok=true.

endpoints.title: GMS config
endpoints.summary: Public GMS config payload (stateful ingestion flags, etc.). Mock returns a stub.

endpoints.title: Ingest a metadata change proposal
endpoints.summary: REST MCP apply. Alternative to GraphQL entity emit. Used by some CLI sinks.

endpoints.title: Legacy entity search
endpoints.summary: Older GMS search action. Prefer GraphQL searchAcrossEntities in new tests.

endpoints.title: Postgres recipe coordinates
endpoints.summary: host_port, username, database, schema_pattern.allow, table_pattern.allow. Sink datahub-rest to datahub-gms.

endpoints.title: Oracle recipe coordinates
endpoints.summary: host_port, username, service_name or database (not both), schema_pattern.allow.

endpoints.title: datahub-gms
endpoints.summary: Generalized Metadata Service. Serves GraphQL and REST. CPU/memory in this lab come from the metrics fixture.

endpoints.title: datahub-mae-consumer
endpoints.summary: Standalone MAE consumer. In this fixture it is CrashLoopBackOff after OOMKilled.

endpoints.title: datahub-mce-consumer
endpoints.summary: Standalone MCE consumer applying proposals.

endpoints.title: datahub-frontend
endpoints.summary: React UI. Public k8s docs port-forward 9002.

endpoints.title: datahub-actions executor
endpoints.summary: Runs UI and scheduled recipes. createIngestionExecutionRequest lands here.

endpoints.title: Upstream lineage aspect
endpoints.summary: upstreamLineage aspect on a dataset. Postgres views use include_view_lineage.

endpoints.title: schemaMetadata aspect
endpoints.summary: Column-level schema for a Dataset. SchemaField nullability and types.

endpoints.title: Container entities
endpoints.summary: Database and schema map to Container subtypes DATABASE and SCHEMA.

endpoints.title: DataJob stored procedures
endpoints.summary: Postgres stored procedures ingest as DataJob under a DataFlow per schema when include_stored_procedures is true.

endpoints.title: OpenAPI entity read
endpoints.summary: OpenAPI v2 entity GET. Mock returns a stub dataset document.

endpoints.title: browseV2
endpoints.summary: Browse containers in the UI. Not required for this lab's API tests.

endpoints.summary: Recipe sink that posts to datahub-gms. server: http://datahub-gms:8080 in this lab.

endpoints.title: aggregateAcrossEntities
endpoints.summary: Facet counts. This lab's mock also answers a compact assetCounts query used by tests.

rca_report.principle: Exit 137 is SIGKILL, not necessarily an OOM kill. Count memory pressure only when Kubernetes last_reason is OOMKilled. The rest is PROBE-KILL. Conflating them sends you to tune memory when the hang is a probe timeout.

fired.symptom: 1 pod(s) hit the memory limit: datahub-mae-consumer.
fired.cause: Container working set reached the pod memory limit. Kubernetes SIGKILL (137) with reason OOMKilled.
fired.likely_cause: Container working set reached the pod memory limit. Kubernetes SIGKILL (137) with reason OOMKilled.
fired.recommendation: Raise that component's memory limit and heap, then confirm Kafka lag drains. Do not scale ingest until this is green.
fired.suggested: Raise that component's memory limit and heap, then confirm Kafka lag drains. Do not scale ingest until this is green.
fired.fix: Raise that component's memory limit and heap, then confirm Kafka lag drains. Do not scale ingest until this is green.

fired.symptom: 1 of 5 pods are not ready: datahub-mae-consumer.

fired.likely_cause: Phase or readiness failed. Combined with MEM-PRESSURE this is CrashLoopBackOff after OOM.

fired.suggested: Restore the crashing component before trusting search, lineage, or MAE-backed UI paths.
fired.fix: Restore the crashing component before trusting search, lineage, or MAE-backed UI paths.

fired.likely_cause: Working set is against the cgroup limit; the next spike OOMKills.

fired.fix: Raise the memory limit (and heap if this is a JVM) before adding ingest load.

fired.suggested: Stagger postgres and oracle recipes; avoid overlapping hourly runs.
fired.fix: Stagger postgres and oracle recipes; avoid overlapping hourly runs.

fired.title: MAE Kafka listener concurrency is 1

fired.symptom: KAFKA_LISTENER_CONCURRENCY=1 on datahub-mae-consumer. One partition/listener cannot drain MetadataAuditEvent_v4 under ingest.
fired.cause: Single-threaded apply plus an OOM loop is why UI search is empty while GMS counts still look fine.
fired.likely_cause: Single-threaded apply plus an OOM loop is why UI search is empty while GMS counts still look fine.
fired.recommendation: Raise MAE listener concurrency with partition count; only after memory headroom exists.
fired.suggested: Raise MAE listener concurrency with partition count; only after memory headroom exists.
fired.fix: Raise MAE listener concurrency with partition count; only after memory headroom exists.

fired.title: CPU at or above 80% of limit

fired.symptom: `datahub-mae-consumer` CPU 88.1% of its limit (percentage of the pod limit, not the node).
fired.cause: Sustained CPU near the limit throttles that component.
fired.likely_cause: Sustained CPU near the limit throttles that component.

fired.fix: Raise the CPU limit or add a replica. A small limit at 95% can still be idle in absolute millicores.

fired.likely_cause: Kubernetes is crash-looping the container. Search/index lag follows MAE restarts.
fired.recommendation: Fix the crash reason (see MEM-PRESSURE / PROBE-KILL) rather than deleting the pod on a loop.
fired.suggested: Fix the crash reason (see MEM-PRESSURE / PROBE-KILL) rather than deleting the pod on a loop.
fired.fix: Fix the crash reason (see MEM-PRESSURE / PROBE-KILL) rather than deleting the pod on a loop.
